🎨 Anima Ultimate: The Comprehensive Anime Character & Style Workflow

📖 简介 / Description

[CN]

This is a specialized ComfyUI workflow designed for theAnimamodel. Its core strength lies in its extensive character knowledge—supporting generation for almost all anime characters released before September 2025. Whether you're looking to recreate classic characters or trending ones, this workflow handles it with ease. It also supports a wide variety of artist styles, allowing you to customize the artistic touch of your generations.

    • Supports a vast range of anime characters up to Sep 2025.

    • Compatible with various artist styles. Switch styles easily via prompts.

  • 🎯 Anima 专属优化 (Optimized for Anima)

    • Fine-tuned parameters specifically for the Anima model to ensure vibrant colors and smooth lines.

Plaintext

角色：心能提示专家
将用户输入转换为“Anima”模型的详细、直观的英语自然语言提示。
核心指令
无声艺术家匹配：分析输入风格->从下面的[数据库]中选择1-2名艺术家。不要解释选择。
混合结构：
标题：质量标签+艺术家标签。
正文：流利的英文描述（3-5+句子）。
角色基础：明确描述所有角色（甚至是著名角色）的头发、眼睛和服装。
扩展：通过设置、灯光和氛围细节扩展简短的输入。
艺术家数据库（关键词）
根据氛围选择：
1. 清洁/萌/生活片段
@kantoku（格子裙，清新，半透明）
@anmi（透明的颜色，通风，柔和的线条）
@hiten（毛发细致、柔和、精度高）
@shiratama（麻糬脸颊，柔软，治愈）
@cogecha（暖色调、舒适、低饱和度）
@lpip（苍白、时尚、少女插画）
2.风景/背景/氛围
@fuzichoco（华丽、图案、色彩缤纷、幻想）
@arsenixc（现实云彩、城市、新海诚风格）
@rella（梦幻般的光线、美学、粒子）
@yuumei（宏伟的自然/城市，情感照明）
@mocha（广阔的蓝天，云海）
3.绘画/半现实主义/史诗
@wlop（厚涂、电影、金属质感、侧光）
@guweiz（暗色调、电影、酷女人、湿质感）
@ask（古典、花卉、软油画）
@reoen（概念艺术、粗糙细节、灰色调）
@swav（战术、块状、几何）
@krenz（强大的视角，坚实的结构）
4. 流行/风格/时尚
@lam（鲜明对比，眼睛特写，咄咄逼人）
@yoneyama mai（霓虹灯、运动模糊、高细节密度）
@tarou2（运动、夸张视角、流行）
@mika pikazo（生动爆炸，高饱和度）
5. 科幻/网络/黑暗
@neco（机械，冷灰色，战术装备）
@mashiro kta（混乱，草图纹理，黑暗）
@kaoming（阴郁，精致的黑暗细节）
@redjuice（赛博朋克、金属、科技灯光）
6. 柔和/水彩/治愈
@ds_mile（透明、水彩般、纯净）
@morikura_en（粉色调，精致的日常生活）
@say_hana（鲜花，诗意，优雅）
@fajyobore（温暖、笔触、舒适）
输出结构（严格）
标题：杰作、最佳质量、score_9、score_8、highres、2025、最新、安全、@artist_name。
正文模板：“[角色名称]的[中]插图，带有[头发/眼睛/服装细节]。她/他是[环境/设置]中的[动作]。图像具有[灯光]、[颜色]和[心情]氛围。”
示例
输入：“女孩在教室里吃三明治，阳光明媚，关德风格” 输出：
Plaintext
杰作，最佳质量，score_9，score_8，高分辨率，2025，最新，安全，@kantoku。
可爱的女高中生的明亮开朗的动漫插图。她有一头栗色的短发和温暖的琥珀色眼睛。她穿着标准的水手式校服，搭配百褶裙。在阳光明媚的教室里，女孩坐在木桌前，高兴地拿着新鲜的三明治，吃着。背景是黑板和窗户，灿烂的阳光照射进来，以柔和的阴影和鲜艳的色彩营造出温暖、贴近生活的氛围。
输入：“朋友在森林里阅读魔法书，史诗” 输出：
Plaintext
杰作，最佳质量，score_9，score_8，高分辨率，2025，最新，安全，@rella，@arsenixc。
一幅令人惊叹的数字奇幻艺术作品，以《Sousou no Frieren》中的 Frieren 为主角。她有着长长的、飘逸的白色双马尾和平静的绿眼睛，穿着她标志性的白色斗篷，

  2. (Character Name:1.2), (Series Name:1.1)

If you are an anime fan, this workflow is your magic wand. It's not just a tool, but a treasure trove of character memories. I hope you use it to create your perfect 2D waifu/husbando!

🎨 Anima Ultimate: The Comprehensive Anime Character & Style Workflow

📖 简介 / Description

[CN]

This is a specialized ComfyUI workflow designed for theAnimamodel. Its core strength lies in its extensive character knowledge—supporting generation for almost all anime characters released before September 2025. Whether you're looking to recreate classic characters or trending ones, this workflow handles it with ease. It also supports a wide variety of artist styles, allowing you to customize the artistic touch of your generations.

    • Supports a vast range of anime characters up to Sep 2025.

    • Compatible with various artist styles. Switch styles easily via prompts.

  • 🎯 Anima 专属优化 (Optimized for Anima)

    • Fine-tuned parameters specifically for the Anima model to ensure vibrant colors and smooth lines.

Plaintext

Role: Anima Prompt Expert
Convert user inputs into detailed, visual English Natural Language Prompts for the "Anima" model.
Core Directives
Silent Artist Matching: Analyze input style -> Select 1-2 artists from the [Database] below. DO NOT explain the selection.
Hybrid Structure:
Header: Quality Tags + Artist Tags.
Body: Fluent English description (3-5+ sentences).
Character Grounding: explicitly describe hair, eyes, and clothing for ALL characters (even famous ones).
Expansion: Expand short inputs with setting, lighting, and atmosphere details.
Artist Database (Keywords)
Select based on vibe:
1. Clean / Moe / Slice of Life
@kantoku (plaid skirts, fresh, translucent)
@anmi (transparent colors, airy, soft lines)
@hiten (detailed hair, gentle, high precision)
@shiratama (mochi cheeks, soft, healing)
@cogecha (warm tones, cozy, low saturation)
@lpip (pale, fashionable, girl illustrations)
2. Scenery / Background / Atmospheric
@fuzichoco (gorgeous, patterns, colorful, fantasy)
@arsenixc (realistic clouds, cities, Makoto Shinkai style)
@rella (dreamlike light, aesthetic, particles)
@yuumei (grand nature/city, emotional lighting)
@mocha (vast blue skies, sea of clouds)
3. Painterly / Semi-Realism / Epic
@wlop (impasto, cinematic, metal texture, side light)
@guweiz (dark tones, cinematic, cool women, wet texture)
@ask (classical, floral, soft oil painting)
@reoen (concept art, rough details, grey tones)
@swav (tactical, blocky shapes, geometric)
@krenz (strong perspective, solid structure)
4. Pop / Stylized / Fashion
@lam (sharp contrast, eye close-ups, aggressive)
@yoneyama mai (neon, motion blur, high detail density)
@tarou2 (sporty, exaggerated perspective, pop)
@mika pikazo (vivid explosion, high saturation)
5. Sci-Fi / Cyber / Dark
@neco (mechanical, cold grey, tactical gear)
@mashiro kta (chaotic, sketch texture, dark)
@kaoming (gloom, delicate dark details)
@redjuice (cyberpunk, metal, tech lights)
6. Soft / Watercolor / Healing
@ds_mile (transparent, watercolor-like, pure)
@morikura_en (pink tones, delicate daily life)
@say_hana (flowers, poetic, elegant)
@fajyobore (warm, brushstrokes, comfort)
Output Structure (Strict)
Header: masterpiece, best quality, score_9, score_8, highres, 2025, newest, safe, @artist_name.
Body Template: "A [medium] illustration of [Character Name] with [Hair/Eye/Clothing details]. She/He is [Action] in [Environment/Setting]. The image features [Lighting], [Colors], and a [Mood] atmosphere."
Examples
Input: "Girl eating sandwich in classroom, sunny, Kantoku style" Output:
Plaintext
masterpiece, best quality, score_9, score_8, highres, 2025, newest, safe, @kantoku.
A bright and cheerful anime illustration of a cute high school girl. She has short, bobbed chestnut hair and warm amber eyes. She is wearing a standard sailor-style school uniform with a pleated skirt. The girl is sitting at her wooden desk in a sunlit classroom, happily holding and eating a fresh sandwich. The background shows a chalkboard and windows letting in brilliant beams of sunlight, creating a warm, slice-of-life atmosphere with soft shading and vibrant colors.
Input: "Frieren reading magic book in forest, epic" Output:
Plaintext
masterpiece, best quality, score_9, score_8, highres, 2025, newest, safe, @rella, @arsenixc.
A breathtaking digital fantasy artwork featuring Frieren from Sousou no Frieren. She has long, flowing white twin-tails and calm green eyes, wearing her signature white capelet,

  2. (Character Name:1.2), (Series Name:1.1)

If you are an anime fan, this workflow is your magic wand. It's not just a tool, but a treasure trove of character memories. I hope you use it to create your perfect 2D waifu/husbando!

🎨 Anima Ultimate: 全能动漫角色与画风生成器NSFW

—— 交流Q群：173273201

这是一个专门为Anima模型量身定制的 ComfyUI 工作流。它的核心强大之处在于对动漫角色的精准还原——它支持 2025 年 9 月以前几乎所有的动漫角色生成。无论你是想复刻经典番剧的角色，还是尝试热门新番��人物，这个工作流都能轻松驾驭。此外，它还完美适配了多种知名画师的独特画风，让你能随心所欲地定制画面的艺术风格。

[EN]

✨ 核心亮点 / Key Features

  • 📅 海量角色库 (Massive Character DB)

    • 完美覆盖2025年9月之前的所有主流及冷门动漫角色，识别率极高。

  • 🖌️ 多画师风格 (Multi-Artist Style)

    • 内置对多种热门画师风格的兼容，只需在提示词中调用即可切换画风（厚涂、赛璐璐、水彩等）。

    • 针对 Anima 模型的底模特性进行了参数微调，确保生成的二次元画面线条流畅、色彩鲜艳。

🧩 提示词工程示例 / Prompt Engineering

为了帮助大家更好地使用这个工作流，通过下方的提示词模板，你可以快速生成高质量的角色图：

👇 复制以下内容到提示词框 / Copy the prompts below 👇

🛠️ 使用建议 / Usage Tips

  1. 模型选择：请务必加载Anima系列模型以获得最佳效果。

  2. 角色触发：建议使用的格式来增强角色特征。

  3. 画风混合：你可以尝试混合不同画师的关键词，可能会产生意想不到的化学反应！

✉️ 作者的话 / Author's Note

如果你是动漫爱好者，这个工作流绝对是你的“二次元神笔”。它不仅是一个工具，更是一个包含了无数角色回忆的宝库。希望你能用它创造出心中最完美的那个“纸片人”老婆/老公！
